Police Team Attacked During Raid in Rajgarh, Several Injured

A joint team of Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh police was attacked by villagers in Rajgarh while conducting a raid. During the incident, villagers threw stones at the police, resulting in injuries to three police personnel. The mob also allegedly freed an accused from police custody. The incident occurred during a police operation.
